title: OpenSSH signal handling race
summary: A signal handling race in sshd can permit remote unauthenticated attacks on affected versions.
mitigation: Check the release-specific Ubuntu advisory; install the fixed openssh package for that release and verify the running service has been restarted.

classroom_observation.description: Active scenario for an isolated training image; not evidence about a real host. XZ scenarios assess experimental builds, not released Ubuntu.

title: glibc dynamic loader overflow
summary: GLIBC_TUNABLES processing can allow local privilege escalation through affected setuid programs.
mitigation: Identify the distribution release and glibc version; install its vendor security update and restart affected processes.

classroom_observation.description: Active scenario for an isolated training image; not evidence about a real host. XZ scenarios assess experimental builds, not released Ubuntu.

title: XZ upstream supply-chain compromise
summary: Malicious code was found in upstream xz 5.6.x tarballs. Ubuntu states no released Ubuntu versions were affected.
mitigation: Check package provenance and the vendor advisory. Released Ubuntu versions are not affected; investigate experimental images separately.
